title: Metric Markov cotype of ℓ1 and Hilbert-space Lipschitz extension

result.label: Metric Markov cotype of ℓ1 and Hilbert-space Lipschitz extension
result.statement: Proves that real ℓ 1 has metric Markov cotype two, answering Mendel and Naor's question. Consequently, every Lipschitz map from an arbitrary subset of a real Hilbert space into ℓ 1 extends to the whole space with a universal multiplicative loss in its Lipschitz constant, resolving Ball's extension problem for this target.
